# Notesflix 101: every chapter and part

> Interactive CBSE notes for Classes 9 to 12 from Notesflix 101 (founder: Vishal Kaushik). Updated 2026-11-12. Parts marked (free) open without a password.

## Class 9 English (Kaveri)

Page: https://notesflix101.com/learn/ix-english.html
Syllabus: the new NCERT English textbook Kaveri (2026-27)
Practice marathon: https://notesflix101.com/marathon.html?s=ix-english (433 questions)

### How I Taught My Grandmother to Read

A grandmother learns to read at sixty-two, and a young narrator becomes her first teacher.

- Rooftop Library Loft (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ie1-1.html — A village story by Sudha Murty: the narrator, Krishtakka, the serial Kashi Yatre, the lessons, character sketch and theme.
- Poem of Praise (password) — Subramania Bharati's ode: refrain, imagery, personification, allusion, tone and mood, plus a descriptive paragraph.

### The Pot Maker

Sentila dreams of making pots, and learns that craft, patience and guidance carry a tradition forward.

- Clay Workshop Fair (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ie2-1.html — A story by Temsula Ao: Sentila, Arenla and Onula, conflict, character, symbol and theme.
- Honour Every Work (password) — The poem Gifts of Grace in free verse, the dignity of labour, and noun clauses, relative clauses and determiners.

### Winds of Change

The story of the Indian hand fan: its origin, regional variety, and a craft facing a changing world.

- Breeze Bazaar (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ie3-1.html — An informative article on the pankha: word origin, Ajanta evidence, regional fans, technology and revival.
- Garden Gallery (password) — Maya Anthony's poem: extended metaphor, imagery, AABB rhyme, tone and mood, plus the active and passive voice.

### Vitamin-M

A funny and warm story about Ravi, his Grandpa and who really needs a memory vitamin.

- Memory Lane Fair (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ie4-1.html — Asha Nehemiah's story: Grandpa, Ravi and Vidya, suspense, irony, humour and respect for elders.
- Senses of Memory (password) — Tagore's poem: refrain, sensory imagery, tone and symbolism, plus modals for advice and duty.

### The World of Limitless Possibilities

An inspiring interview with Dr Deepa Malik on attitude, resilience and ability beyond disability.

- Limitless Arena (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ie5-1.html — Interview with Dr Deepa Malik: Paralympics, resilience, inclusion and writing a speech.
- Nine Gold Medals (password) — David Roth's narrative poem: empathy, unity, tone and contrast, plus reported speech.

### Twin Melodies

A play by Mitra Phukan about tradition, fusion and a father and daughter who learn to listen.

- Twin Stage Studio (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ie6-1.html — Mitra Phukan's play: acts, dialogue, conflict between tradition and fusion, and harmony.
- Friend in Music (password) — Bryanna T. Perkins's lyric poem: metaphors of ocean, rhythm and therapy, tone and mood, plus idioms and phrasal verbs.

### Carrier of Words

The story of Khetaram, a village postman in the Thar desert, and the trust that letters build.

- Desert Post Office (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ie7-1.html — Khetaram, a Gramin Dak Sewak in the Thar desert: duties, hardships, trust and dignity of labour.
- Words That Matter (password) — Charles Swain's poem on the limits of words: hyperbole, simile, blossoms and weeds, tone and mood.

### Follow That Dream

Irene Chua's letter from a mother to her daughter about passion, planning and the courage to follow a dream.

- Dream Launch Pad (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ie8-1.html — Irene Chua's letter to Ming: passion, planning, sacrifice, support and hurdles, with a letter writing skill.
- First Step Bridge (password) — Robert Langley's poem: a solitary challenge, the first step, comfort zone, self belief, plus conditionals.

## Class 9 Hindi (Ganga)

Page: https://notesflix101.com/learn/ix-hindi.html
Syllabus: the new NCERT Hindi textbook Ganga (2026-27)
Practice marathon: https://notesflix101.com/marathon.html?s=ix-hindi (254 questions)

### दो बैलों की कथा

प्रेमचंद की कहानी: हीरा और मोती की मित्रता, स्वाभिमान और अपनेपन की यात्रा।

- मेले का बैल (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ih1-1.html — प्रेमचंद की कहानी दो बैलों की कथा: पात्र, बिछड़ने का दुख, साहस और संदेश।
- शब्दों का भंडार (password) — पर्यायवाची और विलोम शब्द, मुहावरे और गुणवाचक विशेषण: भाषा-बोध का अभ्यास।

### क्या लिखूँ?

पदुमलाल पुन्नालाल बख्शी का निबंध: विषय चुनना, तैयारी करना और विचारों को क्रम में रखना।

- विचारों की खोज (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ih2-1.html — क्या लिखूँ? निबंध की प्रक्रिया: विषय, तैयारी, विचारों का क्रम और लेखन।
- विराम और वाक्य (password) — विराम-चिह्न, सरल, संयुक्त और मिश्र वाक्य, और अनुच्छेद बनाने का नियम।

### संवादहीन

शेखर जोशी की कहानी: सूने घर, ताई के अकेलेपन और बातचीत की ज़रूरत की कथा।

- सूना आँगन (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ih3-1.html — संवादहीन: सूना घर, ताई का अकेलापन, मिट्ठू तोते का साथ और संवाद का संदेश।
- नाम और उसकी जगह (password) — संज्ञा के तीन प्रकार, सर्वनाम के रूप और वाक्य में उनका सही मेल।

### ऐसी भी बातें होती हैं

यतींद्र मिश्र का लता मंगेशकर से साक्षात्कार: बचपन, संगीत की साधना और स्वाभिमान की सीख।

- सुरों की बातचीत (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ih4-1.html — साक्षात्कार का रूप, संगीत की साधना, पिता से मिले संस्कार और स्वाभिमान की सीख।
- काम और उसका ढंग (password) — क्रिया की पहचान, क्रिया-विशेषण के रीति, काल और स्थान प्रकार, और उनका वाक्य में प्रयोग।

### आखिरी चट्टान तक

मोहन राकेश का यात्रा-वृत्तांत: कन्याकुमारी के सागर, सूर्यास्त और आत्मचिंतन की यात्रा।

- सागर का मिलन (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ih5-1.html — यात्रा-वृत्तांत का रूप, कन्याकुमारी के सागर और चट्टानें, सूर्यास्त और आत्मचिंतन।
- एक और अनेक (password) — वचन के दो भेद, लिंग के दो भेद, और क्रिया तथा विशेषण का मेल।

### रीढ़ की हड्डी

जगदीश चंद्र माथुर का व्यंग्य: विवाह की बातचीत, दिखावा और पुरानी सोच पर हँसी में छिपी चोट।

- रिश्ते की बात (password) — रीढ़ की हड्डी: परिवेश, दिखावा, रूढ़ि पर व्यंग्य और पाठक की सोच की परख।
- विराम और चिह्न (password) — विराम-चिह्न, वाक्य के भेद और चिह्न से अर्थ बदलने का अभ्यास।

### मैं और मेरा देश

कन्हैयालाल मिश्र प्रभाकर का निबंध: देश केवल नक्शा नहीं, वह हमारे अपनेपन और कर्म से बनता है।

- मैं और मेरा देश (password) — मैं और मेरा देश: देश की परिभाषा, अपनापन, संस्कृति और कर्तव्य का बोध।
- उपसर्ग और प्रत्यय (password) — उपसर्ग और प्रत्यय की पहचान, मूल शब्द और नए शब्दों की रचना।

### रैदास के पद

संत रैदास के दो पद: चंदन, दीपक और मोती जैसे सरल प्रतीकों में भक्त और प्रभु का अटूट संबंध।

- रैदास के पद (password) — रैदास के पद: भक्ति का सरल रूप, प्रतीकों का सौंदर्य और सच्ची निष्ठा।
- अलंकार (password) — अलंकार: उपमा, उपमेय, उपमान और रूपक की पहचान तथा काव्य-सौंदर्य।

### राम-लक्ष्मण-परशुराम संवाद

तुलसीदास के रामचरितमानस का संवाद: क्रोध, तर्क और विनय, और अंत में मर्यादा की जीत।

- परशुराम संवाद (password) — परशुराम संवाद: धनुष प्रसंग, क्रोध, तर्क और विनय की जीत।
- कारक और विभक्ति (password) — कारक और विभक्ति: कर्ता, कर्म और अधिकरण की पहचान।

### भारती, जय, विजय करे!

निराला की राष्ट्रभक्ति कविता: भारत माता की वंदना, शक्ति, एकता और विजय की कामना।

- भारती, जय, विजय करे (password) — भारती, जय, विजय करे: भारत माता की वंदना, शक्ति, एकता और विजय का संदेश।
- पर्यायवाची और विलोम (password) — पर्यायवाची और विलोम शब्द, और उनसे शब्द-भंडार बढ़ाने का अभ्यास।

### झाँसी की रानी

सुभद्रा कुमारी चौहान की कथा-कविता: रानी लक्ष्मीबाई का साहस और 1857 के विद्रोह की गाथा।

- झाँसी की रानी (password) — झाँसी की रानी: रानी लक्ष्मीबाई का साहस, 1857 का विद्रोह और गाथा की लय।
- संधि (password) — संधि: दीर्घ और गुण संधि के नियम और नए शब्द बनाने का अभ्यास।

### घर की याद

भवानी प्रसाद मिश्र की कविता: दूर रहकर घर की याद, आँगन, परिवार और अपनापन।

- घर की याद (password) — घर की याद: दूरी, स्मृति, विरह और घर का अपनापन।
- अनेकार्थी शब्द (password) — अनेकार्थी शब्द: एक रूप, कई अर्थ और प्रसंग से सही अर्थ का चुनाव।

## Class 9 Science

Page: https://notesflix101.com/learn/ix-science.html
Syllabus: the new NCERT textbook Exploration (2026-27)
Practice marathon: https://notesflix101.com/marathon.html?s=ix-science (756 questions)

### Scientific Enquiry and Measurement

The scientific method, SI units, instruments, errors and lab safety

- Young Scientists Lab (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ix1-1.html — The scientific method and variables, SI units and instruments, accuracy, precision and errors, and laboratory safety, with converters, an error calculator, sorting games and a boss battle.

### Cell: The Building Block of Life

Cell theory, organelles, plant vs animal

- Microscope Lab · Part 1 (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ix2-1.html — Discovery of the cell, prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells, organelles and their functions, plant and animal cells, with a magnification calculator, sorting games, memory matches, true/false rushes and a boss battle.
- Cell Fortress · Part 2 (password) — Plasma membrane, diffusion and osmosis with hypotonic, hypertonic and isotonic solutions, mitosis and meiosis with a chromosome counter, cancer and recent advances, with games and a boss battle.

### Tissues in Action

Plant tissues, animal tissues, muscles and bones

- Green City · Part 1 (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ix3-1.html — Meristematic tissue, simple permanent tissues, xylem and phloem, with a tissue identifier, sorting games, memory matches, true/false rushes and a boss battle.
- Body Squad · Part 2 (password) — Epithelial, connective, muscular and nervous tissue, the skeleton, joints and how to keep fit, with a heartbeat calculator, joint finder, sorting games, memory matches and a boss battle.

### Describing Motion Around Us

Speed, velocity, acceleration, graphs and equations

- Race Track · Part 1 (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ix4-1.html — Distance and displacement, speed and velocity, acceleration, and distance–time and velocity–time graphs with live graph playgrounds, solvers, sorting games, memory matches and a boss battle.
- Stunt Arena · Part 2 (password) — The three equations of motion from the velocity–time graph, step-by-step problem solving, braking and free fall, and uniform circular motion, with solvers, a graph playground, sorting games and a boss battle.

### Exploring Mixtures and their Separation

Solutions, colloids, concentration and separation

- Juice Bar Lab · Part 1 (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ix5-1.html — Pure substances and mixtures, solutions, colloids and suspensions with the Tyndall effect, and concentration by mass and volume percent, with solvers, sorting games, memory matches and a boss battle.
- Clean Water Crew · Part 2 (password) — Filtration, evaporation, centrifugation, sublimation, crystallisation, distillation, coagulation and paper chromatography with Rf calculations, method finders, sorting games and a boss battle.

### How Forces Affect Motion

Force, inertia, friction, momentum and Newton's laws

- Tug of War · Part 1 (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ix6-1.html — Force, balanced and unbalanced forces, Newton's first law and inertia, and friction with a net-force calculator, a will-it-move simulator, sorting games, memory matches and a boss battle.
- Rocket Pad · Part 2 (password) — Momentum, Newton's second law and F = ma, the third law with rockets and recoil, and conservation of momentum in collisions, with solvers, a graph playground, sorting games and a boss battle.

### Work, Energy and Simple Machines

Work, energy, power, pulleys, ramps and levers

- Power Plant · Part 1 (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ix7-1.html — Work and the joule, kinetic and potential energy, conservation of energy and power with the watt, with calculators, a KE graph playground, sorting games and a boss battle.
- Workshop · Part 2 (password) — Levers and their three classes, fixed and movable pulleys, inclined planes, mechanical advantage and efficiency, with calculators, a graph playground, sorting games and a boss battle.

### Journey Inside the Atom

Particles, models, shells, valency, isotopes and isobars

- Atom Lab · Part 1 (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ix8-1.html — Electrons, protons and neutrons, Thomson's plum pudding, Rutherford's gold foil experiment and Bohr's shells, with calculators, sorting games and a boss battle.
- Shell Builders · Part 2 (password) — Atomic number and mass number, electron shells up to calcium, valency, isotopes, isobars and their uses, with an atom counter, configuration builder, sorting games and a boss battle.

### Atomic Foundation of Matter

Laws of combination, Dalton, molecules, ions, formulae and molecular mass

- Reaction Harbour · Part 1 (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ix9-1.html — Conservation of mass, constant proportions, Dalton's atomic theory, molecules, atomicity and ions, with calculators, sorting games and a boss battle.
- Formula Foundry · Part 2 (password) — Chemical symbols and valency, the criss-cross method, molecular mass and formula unit mass, with a formula maker, mass calculators, sorting games and a boss battle.

### Sound

Waves, pitch, loudness, speed, echo and echolocation

- Echo Valley · Part 1 (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ix10-1.html — How sound is produced, longitudinal waves with compressions and rarefactions, wavelength, frequency, amplitude and v = fλ, with a wave graph playground, calculators, sorting games and a boss battle.
- Sonar Squad · Part 2 (password) — Pitch and loudness, speed of sound in different media, echo and the 17 m rule, reverberation, ultrasound, echolocation and SONAR, with distance calculators, sorting games and a boss battle.

### Reproduction

Asexual and sexual reproduction, flowers, humans and reproductive health

- Garden Nursery · Part 1 (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ix11-1.html — Why organisms reproduce, asexual methods, sexual reproduction and flower parts, pollination, fertilisation and seed dispersal, with a fission counter, sorting games and a boss battle.
- Life Story Lab · Part 2 (password) — The human reproductive systems, fertilisation, pregnancy and birth, the menstrual cycle, reproductive health and family planning, with calculators, sorting games and a boss battle.

### Diversity in Living Organisms

Classification, five kingdoms, plants, animals and naming

- Species Safari · Part 1 (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ix12-1.html — Why we classify, the taxonomic hierarchy, Whittaker's five kingdoms and binomial nomenclature, with a kingdom finder, a name builder, sorting games and a boss battle.
- Ark Explorers · Part 2 (password) — The five plant groups, invertebrate phyla and vertebrate classes, viruses and the three-domain system, with group finders, sorting games and a boss battle.

### Earth as a System

Spheres, solar energy, winds, water, carbon, nitrogen and oxygen cycles

- Planet Control Room · Part 1 (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/ix13-1.html — The five spheres of Earth, solar energy and the electromagnetic spectrum, differential heating, winds and sea and land breezes, with a heating graph, calculators, sorting games and a boss battle.
- Cycle City · Part 2 (password) — The water, carbon, oxygen and nitrogen cycles and the effect of human activities such as burning fuels and deforestation, with calculators, sorting games and a boss battle.

## Class 9 Social Science (SST)

Page: https://notesflix101.com/learn/ix-sst.html
Syllabus: the new NCERT textbook Understanding Society: India and Beyond (2026-27)
Practice marathon: https://notesflix101.com/marathon.html?s=ix-sst (899 questions)

### Understanding Social Science

The four lenses, evidence, sources, timelines and why citizens study society

- Society Detectives (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/sx1-1.html — History, geography, political science and economics as four lenses, primary and secondary sources, fact and opinion, BCE and CE timelines, and informed citizenship, with a years-between calculator, sorting games and a boss battle.

### Shaping of the Earth's Surface

Layers of the Earth, moving plates, earthquakes, volcanoes, rocks, weathering and landforms

- Earth Core Expedition (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/sx2-1.html — Layers of the Earth, plate tectonics and boundaries, earthquakes and volcanoes, with a plate-distance calculator, a magnitude simulator, sorting games and a boss battle.
- Rocks and Landforms (password) — Igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic rocks and the rock cycle, weathering, erosion and deposition, and mountains, plateaus and plains, with an age-of-layers calculator, a cliff-retreat simulator, sorting games and a boss battle.

### Atmosphere and Climate

Layers of the atmosphere, heat, pressure, winds, weather and the climates of the world

- Sky Station Control (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/sx3-1.html — Gases and layers of the atmosphere, heating and temperature, air pressure and winds, with a lapse-rate calculator, a pressure-gradient simulator, sorting games and a boss battle.
- Weather and Climate (password) — Humidity, condensation and clouds, types of rainfall and the monsoon, weather, climate and global warming, with a relative-humidity calculator, a rainfall simulator, sorting games and a boss battle.

### Early Humans and Beginning of Civilisation

The Stone Age, tools and fire, cave art, the first farmers and the early river-valley civilisations

- The Time Capsule (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/sx4-1.html — Hunter-gatherers of the Old Stone Age, the Mesolithic and Bhimbetka rock art, and the Neolithic first farmers and villages, with a duration calculator, a surplus simulator, sorting games and a boss battle.
- Cities by the Rivers (password) — What makes a civilisation, the planned Harappan cities with their drains, seals and trade, and the river civilisations of Mesopotamia, Egypt and China, with a city-feeding calculator, a street-grid simulator, sorting games and a boss battle.

### State and Society up to 1000 CE

The Vedic age, janapadas and mahajanapadas, the Mauryas, the Guptas and early regional kingdoms

- The Vedic Express (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/sx5-1.html — The Vedas and early Vedic society, iron and the later Vedic age, and the janapadas and mahajanapadas, with a duration calculator, an iron-plough simulator, sorting games and a boss battle.
- Empires and Kingdoms (password) — The Mauryan empire and its administration, Ashoka and dhamma, and the Gupta age and regional kingdoms up to 1000 CE, with a revenue calculator, a BCE-to-CE gap simulator, sorting games and a boss battle.

### Democracy

What democracy means, its features, direct and representative forms, and democracy in India

- Council Island (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/sx6-1.html — The meaning of democracy, its key features, and direct and representative democracy, with an election-winner calculator, an equal-vote simulator, sorting games and a boss battle.
- Why Democracy (password) — Arguments for and against democracy, how the right to vote spread, and democracy in India with its challenges, with a satisfaction calculator, a turnout simulator, sorting games and a boss battle.

### Elections in a Democracy

Why elections, constituencies, voters, candidates and the campaign

- Ballot Box Bazaar (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/sx7-1.html — Purpose of elections, constituencies and reserved seats, voters lists, candidates and the Model Code of Conduct, with a spending-limit calculator, sorting games and a boss battle.
- Fair Play Bazaar (password) — Polling day, EVMs, counting, first past the post and the Election Commission, with turnout, margin and repoll calculators, sorting games and a boss battle.

### Building Blocks in Economics

Wants, scarcity, resources, choice and the problem of opportunity cost

- Castaway Market (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/sx8-1.html — Needs and wants, scarcity, the four factors of production, choice and opportunity cost, with calculators, sorting games and a boss battle.
- Castaway Town (password) — What, how and for whom to produce, the production possibility curve, and market, command and mixed economies, with calculators, sorting games and a boss battle.

### The Price Puzzle

Demand, supply, equilibrium and how market prices are found

- Mango Mela Mystery (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/sx9-1.html — Demand and its law, supply and its law, and the equilibrium price with surplus and shortage, with a demand-supply simulator, sorting games and a boss battle.
- Mango Mela Day Two (password) — Shifts in demand and supply, the new equilibrium, price ceilings and the minimum support price, with simulators, sorting games and a boss battle.

### Oceans and Life

The ocean floor, waves, tides, currents and the life they support

- Deep Dive Academy (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/sy1-1.html — Shelf, slope, plain and trench, waves and tides, and warm and cold currents, with a sonar depth calculator, tide timer, sorting games and a boss battle.
- Living Ocean (password) — Ocean zones, food chains, coral reefs, resources and conservation, with an energy-chain simulator, a fish-stock calculator, sorting games and a boss battle.

### Life on Earth

The biosphere, ecosystems, food webs, biomes and adaptation

- Jungle Pulse Expedition (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/sy2-1.html — The biosphere, producers, consumers and decomposers, the 10 per cent energy rule, and the major biomes with adaptations, with simulators, sorting games and a boss battle.
- Jungle Guardians (password) — Biodiversity, India as a megadiverse country, threats such as habitat loss and poaching, and conservation through parks and reserves, with simulators and a boss battle.

### Resistance and Resilience 1000–1700 CE

Defending the land: Tarain, Vijayanagara, the Ahoms, Rani Durgavati and Maharana Pratap

- Fort Keepers Trail (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/sy3-1.html — The age of challenges, the Vijayanagara Empire and the Ahoms, and brave rulers like Rani Durgavati and Maharana Pratap, with timeline calculators, sorting games and a boss battle.

- Potential Energy and Conservation (Part 2) (password) — Potential energy, conservative and non-conservative forces, conservation of mechanical energy, spring potential energy and motion in a vertical circle, with an energy skate bowl, a spring launcher, the Loop Launch game and the double inclined plane activity.

- NCERT Exercises Solved (password) — All 23 end-of-chapter NCERT exercises of Work, Energy and Power, solved step by step, with hints, an answer checker for numericals and redrawn figures.

### System of Particles and Rotational Motion

Centre of mass, torque, angular momentum and moment of inertia

- Centre of Mass (Part 1) (password) — Centre of mass of two particles, many particles and rigid bodies including a uniform rod, total momentum and the motion of the centre of mass, with a CM Balancer, an exploding firework, the Mobile Maker game and a plumb-line lamina activity.
- Torque, Angular Momentum and Equilibrium (Part 2) (password) — Torque as r x F, angular momentum, tau = dL/dt, conservation of angular momentum, equilibrium of rigid bodies, couples and the principle of moments, with a Torque Door, a Spin Studio, the See-saw Balance game and the metre-scale principle of moments lab.
- Rotational Motion and Moment of Inertia (Part 3) (password) — Rotation about a fixed axis, equations of rotational motion, moment of inertia and radius of gyration, moments of inertia of simple bodies, torque = I alpha, power and the linear-rotational comparison, with a Bead Spinner, a Spin-Up Lab, the Inertia Ranker game, a flywheel activity and the Chapter 6 final test with certificate.
- NCERT Exercises Solved (password) — All 17 end-of-chapter NCERT exercises of System of Particles and Rotational Motion, solved step by step, with hints, an answer checker for numericals and redrawn figures.

## Class 12 Economics

### National Income and Related Aggregates

How a whole country measures what it earns, makes and spends.

- Basic Concepts of Macroeconomics (Part 1) (free): https://notesflix101.com/notes/eco12-ni-1.html — Story, animations, 3D board, simulations and board-exam practice on What is macroeconomics, consumption goods, capital goods, final goods, intermediate goods.
- Circular Flow of Income (Part 2) (password) — Story, animations, 3D board, simulations and board-exam practice on circular flow of income (two-sector model), real flow and money flow, leakages and injections (brief).
- National Income Aggregates (Part 3) (password) — Story, animations, 3D board, simulations and board-exam practice on GDP, GNP, NDP, NNP, at market price and at factor cost, NFIA, depreciation, net indirect taxes.
- Value Added Method (Part 4) (password) — Story, animations, 3D board, simulations and board-exam practice on value added or product method, value of output, intermediate consumption, GVA at MP to NNP at FC.
- Income and Expenditure Methods (Part 5) (password) — Story, animations, 3D board, simulations and board-exam practice on income method: compensation of employees, operating surplus, mixed income, expenditure method: PFCE, GFCE, GDCF, net exports, precautions / items included and excluded.
- Real vs Nominal GDP and Welfare (Part 6) (password) — Story, animations, 3D board, simulations and board-exam practice on real and nominal GDP, GDP deflator, GDP and welfare: distribution, non-monetary exchanges, externalities.
- Revision: Tricky Items and PYQs (Part 7) (password) — Story, animations, 3D board, simulations and board-exam practice on items included / excluded with reasons, components of NFIA, choosing the method; board PYQs.

### Money and Banking

What money really does, how banks create it, and how the RBI controls it.

- Money: Meaning, Functions and Supply (Part 1) (password) — Story, animations, 3D board, simulations and board-exam practice on barter system and its problems, money: meaning and functions, supply of money: currency held by public + net demand deposits.
- Money Creation by Commercial Banks (Part 2) (password) — Story, animations, 3D board, simulations and board-exam practice on money creation by the commercial banking system, legal reserve ratio, money multiplier.
- Central Bank and Credit Control (Part 3) (password) — Story, animations, 3D board, simulations and board-exam practice on RBI functions: bank of issue, government's bank, banker's bank, control of credit: bank rate, CRR, SLR, repo, reverse repo, open market operations, margin requirement.

### Determination of Income and Employment

Why an economy sometimes has too much demand, sometimes too little, and what fixes it.

- Aggregate Demand and Propensities (Part 1) (password) — Story, animations, 3D board, simulations and board-exam practice on aggregate demand and its components, consumption function, APC, MPC, APS, MPS and their relations.
- Short-run Equilibrium Output (Part 2) (password) — Story, animations, 3D board, simulations and board-exam practice on aggregate supply, equilibrium: AD = AS and S = I, 45-degree line approach.
- Investment Multiplier (Part 3) (password) — Story, animations, 3D board, simulations and board-exam practice on investment multiplier and its mechanism, k = 1/(1-MPC) = 1/MPS, numericals.
- Excess and Deficient Demand (Part 4) (password) — Story, animations, 3D board, simulations and board-exam practice on full employment and involuntary unemployment, excess demand (inflationary gap) and deficient demand (deflationary gap), measures: government spending, taxes, money supply.

### Government Budget and the Economy

Where the government's money comes from, where it goes, and what a deficit means.

- Budget Deficits (Part 2) (password) — Story, animations, 3D board, simulations and board-exam practice on balanced, surplus and deficit budget, revenue deficit, fiscal deficit, primary deficit, implications.

### Balance of Payments

- Foreign Exchange Rate (Part 2) (password) — Story, animations, 3D board, simulations and board-exam practice on fixed, flexible and managed floating rates, determination in a free market, merits and demerits of fixed and flexible rates.

- Industry and Foreign Trade 1950-90 (Part 3) (password) — Story, animations, 3D board, simulations and board-exam practice on IPR 1956, small scale industries: role and importance, trade policy: import substitution.

### Economic Reforms since 1991

The 1991 crisis and the LPG reforms, plus demonetisation and GST.

Human capital, rural development, jobs and sustainability.
